Shunza’s “Come Home” Album Cover

A stark black-and-white portrait of Shunza fills the frame, her gaze steady and contemplative. The right side of her face is illuminated, while the left fades into shadow, creating a minimalist yet emotive visual. Shunza Greatest Hits Album Cover

The album cover showcases a close-up portrait of Shunza, the Chinese singer-songwriter, looking back over her shoulder. She wears a sleeveless top that reveals a subtle tattoo on her upper arm, and her dark hair frames her face against a softly blurred background. The title text “順子*精選 Shunza Greatest Hits” is prominently displayed at the top, combining Chinese characters with English words.

source.description:
OPEN UP Album Cover

The cover art for Shunza’s 1999 single "Come Home" features a close-up portrait of the singer looking upward with a serene expression. Her dark hair cascades around her face, set against a softly lit, neutral background that highlights her contemplative gaze.

Bold, vertical lettering spells out "OPEN UP" along the right side, while "SHUN'ZA" and the Chinese characters "顺子" appear near the bottom. This minimalist design underscores the emotional tone of the song and draws attention to Shunza’s presence as the focal point of the artwork.

source.description:
Shunza’s “OPEN UP” Album Cover

A striking close-up profile of Shunza dominates the cover, her dark hair cascading around a pale, softly lit face. The minimalist design features the bold vertical title “OPEN YOUR HEART” and the artist’s name in both English and Chinese (順子), creating a serene yet impactful visual.

This album, titled “OPEN UP,” is listed on ROCKMALL with a 16-track lineup including “IF YOU LEAVE ME NOW,” “DON’T CRY OUT LOUD,” and the title track “OPEN UP.” The clean white background and muted color palette underscore the contemplative mood of the cover art.
